values.en:
A transcription target, not new mathematics. This library exists to
exercise the `Proof.*` package against a proof whose structure is already
fixed — the rendering at https://mitar.top/ — so the SNL tree can be diffed
against a reference instead of judged by taste.

Two properties are being tested. First, that the subgoal decomposition can be
reproduced *identically*: same subgoal statements, same order, same nested
`我们有` blocks. Second, that a step decomposes into atoms — the sentence frame
is a macro and every formula is its own node, so nothing is a paragraph of
Chinese with mathematics embedded in it as string content.
values.zh-CN:
这是一个转录目标，而非新的数学内容。此库用于针对一个结构已经
固定的证明——https://mitar.top/ 上的渲染结果——检验 `Proof.*` 包，
从而可将 SNL 树与参考内容作差异比较，而不是凭审美判断。

这里检验两个性质。第一，子目标分解能否被*完全一致地*复现：相同的
子目标陈述、相同的次序、相同的嵌套 `我们有` 块。第二，一个步骤能否
分解为原子——句子框架是宏，每个公式都是独立节点，因此不会出现把
数学内容作为字符串嵌入其中的整段中文。
